scientific_integrity: The asserted new result is the exact splitting field, explicit six-point Galois actions and resulting finite-field rational-Weierstrass profiles. The input curves, isomorphic unpolarized Jacobians, and generic arithmetic disparity phenomenon are credited to Abdellatif and Howe; tested examples are corroboration, not proof of universal claims.
scientific_limitations: The paper of Abdellatif proves the prerequisite isomorphism of unpolarized Jacobians, not the present separate Weierstrass Galois computation. The complete splitting-field and rational-Weierstrass formulas apply only when t(t²+1)(2t²+1)(t²+2)(t²−1)(t⁴+t²+1) is nonzero in characteristic different from 2. No classification of all same-Jacobian genus-two curves, polarization-preserving isomorphisms, or geometric isomorphism exceptional locus is asserted. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact Weierstrass splitting fields and Frobenius profiles in a genus-two Jacobian-isomorphism family
